title: Luminescent Mushroom
body:
Description

The Luminescent Mushroom is a type of Mushroom found underwater within an underground cave system below the Azure Fields. This cave lies beneath the cluster of small, interconnected islands characterized by blue-colored grass and surrounded by large formations of Azurite crystals, which also densely line the cave entrance and interior.

The Luminescent Mushroom is notable for its glowing cap and tall, slender stem, but it poses environmental hazards to those who approach it. When disturbed, it releases bubbles from beneath its cap that travel toward nearby players, causing the player to be launched upwards and be damaged while partially replenishing oxygen. Due to these conditions, harvesting Luminescent Mushrooms is considered hazardous and is typically undertaken using scooba equipment, such as a Rusty Scooba Tank or the more efficient Refined Scooba Tank, particularly when gathering large quantities or transporting them by vehicle.

Trivia

  • If the Luminescent Mushroom is hit once, it acts dormant and stops shooting bubbles. This can be very useful for grinding Luminescent Mushrooms.
